hi: हम लोग एक थ्री बीएचके फ्लैट देख रहे हैं, पुणे में, बानेर के आसपास।
literal: We people are looking at a three BHK flat, in Pune, around Baner.
fluent: We're looking at a 3BHK flat in Pune, around Baner.

hi: टोटल बजट हमारा डेढ़ करोड़ है, उससे ज़्यादा स्ट्रेच नहीं कर सकते।
literal: Our total budget is one and a half crore, we cannot stretch more than that.
fluent: Our total budget is ₹1.5 crore; we can't stretch beyond that.

hi: डाउन पेमेंट हम साढ़े तीन लाख… मतलब शुरू में इतना दे सकते हैं।
literal: Down payment we three and a half lakh... meaning at the start we can give this much.
fluent: We can make a down payment of about ₹3.5 lakh upfront.

hi: और महीने की ईएमआई सवा लाख तक चल जाएगी।
literal: And the monthly EMI up to one and a quarter lakh will work.
fluent: And we can manage an EMI of up to ₹1.25 lakh a month.

hi: साइट विज़िट कल चार बजे… नहीं नहीं, साढ़े चार बजे रख लीजिए।
literal: Site visit tomorrow at four o'clock... no no, keep it at half past four.
fluent: Please schedule the site visit for 4:30 tomorrow.

hi: और बिल्डर से पूछ लेना कि पज़ेशन कब तक मिलेगा।
literal: And ask the builder that by when the possession will be received.
fluent: And ask the builder when we'll get possession.
